figures.caption: Figure 2: RL training system for mobile agent. We integrate GRPO with a scalable rollout collection system that parallelizes multiple environments. Docker containerization provides resource isolation and decouples trainer and environments through HTTP communication for reliability. Asynchronous rollouts eliminate synchronization bottlenecks, enabling more agent steps per unit time. Together, these three techniques facilitate reliable and efficient large-scale training.
